en.headline: FIFA ASEAN Cup 2026 awarded M Mark status
en.dek: The Major Sports Events Committee endorsed the four-match tournament, which opens at Mong Kok Stadium on Thursday before moving to Kai Tak.
body: The Major Sports Events Committee has awarded M Mark status to the FIFA ASEAN Cup 2026, a four-match tournament that begins on Thursday at Mong Kok Stadium.

According to a government announcement on Tuesday, subsequent matches will be played on 27 and 30 September and 3 October at Kai Tak Stadium. National teams from Southeast Asia will compete alongside the Hong Kong, China team.

Committee chairman Wilfred Ng said fans would be able to watch the matches in person and support the home side, and that the event would show Hong Kong's appeal as a host of international sports events.
M Mark recognition is given to major sports events staged in the city that meet the committee's criteria on organisation, spectator appeal and economic contribution.

zh.headline: FIFA東盟盃獲「M」品牌資格 周四旺角揭幕
zh.dek: 大型體育活動委員會向2026年FIFA東盟盃頒發「M」品牌資格，周四先於旺角場開賽，其後轉戰啟德體育園。
body: 大型體育活動委員會已向2026年FIFA東盟盃頒發「M」品牌資格。賽事周四先於旺角大球場揭幕。
政府周二公布，其餘場次將於9月27日、9月30日及10月3日在啟德體育園舉行，東南亞各國家隊將與中國香港隊同場作賽。
委員會主席伍衛國表示，球迷可近距離觀看賽事，為港隊打氣，活動亦有助展示香港作為國際體育盛事之都的吸引力。
「M」品牌用以表揚在港舉行、符合委員會在籌辦、觀眾吸引力及經濟效益等準則的大型體育活動。
